notes: Second session after the illness, and better than before it. He chose Push over legs (Lower A moved to Friday), added a third set to everything and finished with abs and the first Copenhagen plank ever. Shoulder press 60 x 7.5 is new territory; incline hit the top of the range on all three sets. Patterns: he climbs above the cap when he feels good, and halves the load on the last set when a set felt hard (pec deck 20 -> 10).
